title: Hotels, resorts, malls line up Halloween events across PH
summary: From a Halloween party at Nobu Manila to pirate-themed adventures in Samal and undersea celebrations in Batangas, hotels, malls and resorts are preparing a variety of activities for Halloween weekend.
